data.narrative:
Defense Unicorns, a Series B defense and security technology company led by Rob Slaughter, Jeff McCoy, and Andrew Greene, has raised $171M to date and carries a last post-money valuation of $1.0B. The valuation analysis triangulates across a comp universe of 10 private and 2 public frontier-defense firms, with particular focus on five same-stage, same-sector private peers: Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Heven AeroTech ($1.0B), and TurbineOne ($300M).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier—typical for Series B advancement—to the $1.0B last post money, implying a valuation of $1.9B. Peer-median analysis across the five comparables yields a median valuation of $1.2B, with peer valuations spanning $300M to $3.0B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in the frontier-defense sector and varying technology maturity across stages.

Triangulation of both methods produces a valuation range of $1.1B (low) to $2.2B (high), with a median implied value of $1.6B. The current $1.0B post-money sits at the lower bound of this range. Key uncertainties include the applicability of the 1.9x stage multiplier to capital-intensive defense applications and whether peer valuations fully reflect Defense Unicorns' specific technical differentiation and customer concentration.
